steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings are identical on every point I could check.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Product and specs | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite, same box contents | Same |

The two listings show the same rating and the same number of reviews. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to each seller, so they don't tell you which seller is better.

Here is how I'd decide:
- **Check the seller's reputation elsewhere.** Look for independent seller ratings, or for complaints about shipping problems or refund delays. The listings don't show any of this.
- **Look at the total at checkout.** Tax, shipping, or fees might differ even though the listed prices match.
- **Pick the one that's easier to deal with.** If you already have an account with one of them, or if one offers a payment method you prefer, use that one.

If neither seller stands out after those checks, pick either. The terms are the same, so you're taking on no more risk with one than the other.
